# The small and sim profiles do not read this file: small keeps its own per-config budget (plan-matrix.py BUDGET, TLC_TIMEOUT).
# Env overrides for hand runs: TLC_TIMEOUT (seconds, every row) and TLC_JAVA_OPTS (JVM options; a later -Xmx there wins over the row).
# @hosted is not a row: it is the largest budget that fits a GitHub-hosted runner (a job is capped at 6 h, the runner has about 16 GB):
# 18000 s leaves the job 1 h of the 350 min plan-matrix.py gives it; 12g leaves the OS, the JIT and the resource guard (2 GB) their share.
# [guess: both limits are judgement, not measured on a hosted runner; change them here, nowhere else.]
# A row over either limit is never run on a runner and never silently skipped: run.sh prints and records SKIPPED-HOST <row>, and
# tools/tla/run-host.sh runs it on a build host under its budget.

# The measured times are build-host times (16 cores, 3-4 workers); a hosted runner is slower [unverified: one sample, ~1.7x: SharedPools small 257 s on a hosted runner vs 150 s on cloudbb-6 at TLC_WORKERS=4].
# Budgets are about twice the time measured by hand at rc6 b039c74482 (#3636); heap is what the run used (SharedPools/live ran out of
